prompt.zh-TW: 青田農產向農民進貨一律當場付現，年底應付帳款是 {{money:vars.ap}}；今年本期進貨 {{money:vars.purchases}}。依課程 Excel 版計算應付款項週轉率，以「次」作答；算不出來時請按「N/A」。
prompt.en: Green Field Produce always pays the farmers it buys from in cash on the spot, so trade payables at year end are {{money:vars.ap}}; purchases this year were {{money:vars.purchases}}. Using the course Excel version, what is the payables turnover? Answer in times; if it cannot be calculated, press ‘N/A’.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_2jyfy0hn}}的分母是{{term:tm_a3p9y6kc}}。分母為零時除法沒有定義，比率不存在，顯示 N/A，不是零；零會是「有應付帳款、但本期進貨剛好是零」的情況。這和課程的計算口徑一致：分母為零一律顯示 N/A。
explanation.en: The denominator of {{term:tm_2jyfy0hn}} is {{term:tm_a3p9y6kc}}. With a zero denominator the division is undefined, so the ratio does not exist and shows N/A, not zero; zero would be the case of having payables while purchases for the period happen to be zero. This matches the course’s calculation basis: a zero denominator always shows N/A.
